translations.web: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
translations.bsb: I hope you will put up with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.
translations.kjv: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
